answer: Unpredictable liveness checks price fakes. A falcon check arrives at random: within ten minutes the identity must answer from its relic history, sign with its key, and post on the meadow board for audit; a miss burns a 50-credit bond and freezes it one epoch. One operator covers at most 20 identities, as random windows overlap, so the 21st fake forces a second operator and 1,000 fakes need 50 operators (1,500 credits per epoch) plus 50,000 at risk; an honest identity answers free, bond intact. Rented liveness fails: a stand-in lacks the relic history and has the wrong key.
